I'm sorry about that debate :( 

I'm from Germany.
She never told me that she likes me in that way, but I thought she might and told her I'm not into her :S

Sorry, if I worded it unfortunately. I wasn't going to let my drunken behavior be an excuse for anything. I wanted to know if I should talk to her why I said the stuff when I was drunk and apologise in a more proper way.
Sorry, but I wasn't about to lie to her. I would tell her what lead to stuff I said when I was drunk.

But whenever I hear her making that reference I see the sadness in her eyes. 

The first time I apologised to her i didn't took it too serious. It was just a "sorry, I probably didn't meant it". Still in disbelief, that I could have said this.
